projects.label: Selected Work
projects.title: MyStar — Taking Staroptic from physical retail to e-commerce
projects.intro: I built MyStar from the ground up as Staroptic’s dedicated Shopify storefront, creating a structured bilingual sales channel for eyewear and prescription ordering.
projects.ownership: Sole Developer · Built from the Ground Up

overview.title: Business Context
overview.copy: Staroptic is an established optical retailer that launched MyStar as its dedicated online brand and sales channel.

overview.title: Challenge
overview.copy: The storefront needed to organize a complex eyewear catalogue and translate key parts of the in-store optical sales process into a clear online journey.

overview.title: My Role
overview.copy: I led the storefront architecture, Shopify and frontend development, UX/UI decisions, localization, technical SEO, app integration, QA and ongoing improvements.

highlights.title: Store Architecture
highlights.copy: A clear structure connects sunglasses, prescription glasses, women’s and men’s collections across the storefront.

highlights.title: Product Discovery
highlights.copy: Collections and filters help customers narrow the catalogue by relevant eyewear characteristics.

highlights.title: Product Page UX
highlights.copy: Pricing, frame specifications, sizing and purchase options are organized to reduce uncertainty.

prescription.label: Standout Feature
prescription.title: Prescription ordering adapted to the real optical sales process
prescription.copy: The functionality is powered by a third-party application that I integrated, configured and adapted to Staroptic’s requirements. The UX flow was developed in consultation with Staroptic employees so the online process reflects the information customers need when ordering prescription glasses.

about.label: Why Work With Me
about.title: Thoughtful decisions, precise execution and clear ownership.
about.intro: I stay close to both the business goal and the implementation—asking the right questions early, identifying UX and technical risks, and carrying each decision through to a launch-ready result.

differentiators.title: Precision beyond the visual
differentiators.description: Visual accuracy is only one part of a refined result. I pay equal attention to content hierarchy, interaction states, responsive behavior and the small inconsistencies that shape how a product feels to use.

differentiators.title: Technical depth beyond the interface
differentiators.description: I work beyond basic theme configuration and visual implementation, considering structure, data, integrations and maintainability so the finished product remains practical to manage and extend.

differentiators.title: One clear point of ownership
differentiators.description: From understanding requirements and planning the approach to development, QA and launch, I remain directly involved. Communication stays clear, decisions keep their context and fewer details are lost between handoffs.

differentiators.title: Quality built into development
differentiators.description: Performance, technical SEO and accessibility are considered while the product is being built—not added as a final checklist once the main work is complete.

credibility.remainder: across Shopify agency work and structured software-engineering environments shaped the way I combine commercial awareness with disciplined delivery.

credibility.label: Experience & Education
credibility.title: Shopify specialization backed by engineering depth and academic distinction.
credibility.intro: My professional path combines current Shopify agency work with lead responsibility in enterprise software development, supported by an academic progression marked by exceptional performance and repeated official recognition.

roles.description: Working within a Shopify Plus Partner agency on client storefront delivery, e-commerce development and frontend implementation. This experience keeps my Shopify specialization grounded in real agency workflows and client projects.

Progressed from Software Developer to Lead Software Developer in a structured engineering environment focused on enterprise and business-critical internal systems. The experience reflects long-term application development, technical ownership and disciplined delivery.

roles.label: Earlier professional foundation

process.label: How We Work Together
process.title: A clear path from first conversation to launch.
process.intro: You always know what is being decided, what comes next and what I need from you. I keep the process focused and involve you at the points where your input matters.

steps.title: Discovery & Alignment
steps.description: We begin with a focused conversation about your business, audience, requirements and what the project needs to accomplish. I identify priorities, dependencies and important constraints early so we start from a shared understanding.

steps.title: Scope & Technical Direction
steps.description: Together, we confirm deliverables, responsibilities, milestones and project boundaries. I define the technical direction and clarify the content, assets and access needed before development begins.

steps.title: Design, Development & Reviews
steps.description: I turn the agreed direction into working interfaces and functionality, making UX/UI and implementation decisions in context. You review progress at planned checkpoints—often through a preview or staging environment—so feedback stays timely and revisions remain focused.

steps.title: QA, Launch & Handoff
steps.description: Before launch, I test responsive behavior, functionality and the final technical setup across relevant devices and scenarios. I then handle or support deployment and provide the agreed handoff, documentation or training needed to manage the finished product.

process.support: Optional ongoing support and improvements are available after launch.

guarantee.label: A Personal Standard
guarantee.title: Everything I promise, I stand behind.
guarantee.primary: I take personal responsibility for the quality of every project I deliver—from the decisions made along the way to the details that shape the finished result. The work should feel considered, dependable and ready for real use.
guarantee.followup: If something needs refinement, I refine it.
guarantee.signatureNote: My personal commitment to quality, clear communication and follow-through.

projects.label: Odabrani projekat
projects.title: MyStar — Novi e-commerce kanal za Staroptic
projects.intro: MyStar sam razvila od početka kao zaseban Shopify storefront kojim je Staroptic svoje maloprodajno poslovanje proširio na online prodaju.

overview.title: Poslovni kontekst
overview.copy: Staroptic je etablirana optika koja je kroz MyStar pokrenula zaseban online brend i prodajni kanal.

overview.title: Izazov
overview.copy: Bilo je potrebno jasno organizovati složen katalog i deo stručnog procesa prodaje naočara prilagoditi samostalnoj online kupovini.

overview.title: Moja uloga
overview.copy: Bila sam odgovorna za arhitekturu storefronta, Shopify i frontend razvoj, UX/UI odluke, lokalizaciju, tehnički SEO, integraciju aplikacija, QA i dalja unapređenja.

highlights.title: Arhitektura prodavnice
highlights.copy: Jasna podela povezuje sunčane i dioptrijske modele sa ženskim i muškim kolekcijama.

highlights.title: Pronalaženje proizvoda
highlights.copy: Kolekcije i filteri pomažu kupcima da suze izbor prema relevantnim karakteristikama naočara.

highlights.title: UX produkt stranice
highlights.copy: Cena, specifikacije rama, dimenzije i opcije kupovine organizovane su tako da smanje nedoumice.

prescription.label: Ključna funkcionalnost
prescription.title: Poručivanje dioptrijskih naočara prilagođeno stvarnom procesu optike
prescription.copy: Funkcionalnost koristi aplikaciju treće strane koju sam integrisala, konfigurisala i prilagodila zahtevima Staroptica. UX tok je definisan u konsultaciji sa zaposlenima kako bi online proces obuhvatio informacije potrebne za poručivanje dioptrijskih naočara.

about.label: Zašto sarađivati sa mnom
about.title: Promišljene odluke, precizna realizacija i jasna odgovornost.
about.intro: Podjednako sam uključena u razumevanje poslovnog cilja i samu realizaciju—na početku postavljam prava pitanja, prepoznajem UX i tehničke rizike i svaku odluku sprovodim do rešenja spremnog za lansiranje.

differentiators.title: Preciznost koja ide dalje od vizuelnog
differentiators.description: Vizuelna preciznost je samo jedan deo kvalitetnog rezultata. Jednaku pažnju posvećujem hijerarhiji sadržaja, stanjima interakcije, responzivnom ponašanju i sitnim nedoslednostima koje oblikuju celokupno korisničko iskustvo.

differentiators.title: Tehnička dubina iza interfejsa
differentiators.description: Ne zadržavam se na osnovnom podešavanju teme i vizuelnoj realizaciji. Razmišljam o strukturi, podacima, integracijama i održivosti kako bi završeno rešenje bilo praktično za upravljanje i dalji razvoj.

differentiators.title: Jedna osoba, jasna odgovornost
differentiators.description: Od razumevanja zahteva i planiranja do razvoja, QA provere i lansiranja, ostajem direktno uključena. Komunikacija ostaje jasna, odluke zadržavaju kontekst, a važni detalji se ne gube između različitih izvođača.

differentiators.title: Kvalitet ugrađen u razvoj
differentiators.description: Performanse, tehnički SEO i pristupačnost uzimam u obzir tokom razvoja, umesto da ih dodajem tek kao završnu kontrolu.

credibility.remainder: rada u Shopify agencijskom i strukturiranom softversko-inženjerskom okruženju oblikovalo je moj pristup preciznoj i pouzdanoj isporuci.

credibility.label: Iskustvo i obrazovanje
credibility.title: Shopify specijalizacija oslonjena na inženjersku dubinu i akademska dostignuća.
credibility.intro: Moj profesionalni put povezuje aktuelni rad u Shopify agenciji sa vodećom ulogom u razvoju poslovno kritičnih softverskih sistema, uz akademski razvoj obeležen izuzetnim uspehom i ponovljenim zvaničnim priznanjima.

roles.description: U okviru Shopify Plus partnerske agencije radim na isporuci prodavnica za klijente, razvoju e-commerce rešenja i frontend realizaciji. Ovo iskustvo povezuje moju Shopify specijalizaciju sa stvarnim agencijskim procesima i projektima za klijente.

Od pozicije Software Developer napredovala sam do vodeće uloge u strukturiranom inženjerskom okruženju usmerenom na poslovno kritične interne i enterprise sisteme. Ovo iskustvo predstavlja dugoročan razvoj aplikacija, tehničku odgovornost i disciplinovan način isporuke.

roles.label: Ranija profesionalna osnova
roles.description: Rano profesionalno iskustvo u velikom korporativnom okruženju pružilo mi je praktičan uvid u poslovne sisteme, strukturirane timske procese i profesionalnu isporuku softvera.

process.label: Kako izgleda saradnja
process.title: Jasan put od prvog razgovora do lansiranja.
process.intro: U svakom trenutku znate koje odluke donosimo, šta sledi i šta mi je potrebno sa vaše strane. Proces držim fokusiranim i uključujem vas onda kada je vaš doprinos važan.

steps.title: Razumevanje cilja i usaglašavanje
steps.description: Počinjemo fokusiranim razgovorom o poslovanju, publici, zahtevima i cilju koji projekat treba da ispuni. Prioritete, važne zavisnosti i ograničenja prepoznajem na početku kako bismo imali zajedničko razumevanje.

steps.title: Obim i tehnički pravac
steps.description: Zajedno potvrđujemo šta tačno isporučujem, ko je za šta odgovoran, ključne rokove i granice projekta. Definišem tehnički pravac i unapred preciziramo potreban sadržaj, materijale i pristupe sistemima.

steps.title: Dizajn, razvoj i zajednički pregledi
steps.description: Dogovoreni pravac pretvaram u funkcionalno digitalno rešenje, donoseći UX/UI i razvojne odluke u kontekstu projekta. Napredak pregledamo u dogovorenim tačkama, po potrebi kroz testno okruženje, kako bi povratne informacije stigle na vreme, a dorade ostale fokusirane.

steps.title: Provera kvaliteta, lansiranje i predaja
steps.description: Pre lansiranja proveravam responzivno ponašanje, funkcionalnosti i završnu tehničku postavku na relevantnim uređajima i kroz realne scenarije korišćenja. Zatim preuzimam lansiranje ili pružam podršku tokom objavljivanja i predajem dogovorenu dokumentaciju, smernice ili kratku obuku kada je potrebna.

process.support: Po potrebi, saradnja može da se nastavi kroz dalju podršku i unapređenja nakon lansiranja.

guarantee.label: Lični standard
guarantee.title: Za sve što obećam, ličnim imenom stojim iza toga.
guarantee.primary: Lično preuzimam odgovornost za kvalitet svakog projekta koji isporučim—od odluka koje donosimo tokom saradnje do detalja koji oblikuju završni rezultat. Rešenje treba da bude promišljeno, pouzdano i spremno za stvarnu upotrebu.
guarantee.followup: Ako nešto zahteva doradu, dorađujem ga.
guarantee.signatureNote: Moj lični potpis na kvalitet, jasnu komunikaciju i odgovornu isporuku.
